title: HandoffConfig
description: Optional project config for handoff-md (handoff.config.json or .handoffrc). CLI flags override these values.

format.description: Output density. Affects default per-section token budgets and total size cap.

profile.description: Preset section toggles and shrink level (e.g. ci uses a tighter layout).

output.description: Path to write HANDOFF.md (default: HANDOFF.md in project root).

overlay.description: Markdown file merged into the ## Notes section (default: .handoff.overlay.md).

ignoreDirs.description: Directory names skipped when walking the repo tree (in addition to gitignore).

configFiles.description: Extra config files to surface in the ## Config section.

sections.description: Enable or disable HANDOFF sections by id.

github.description: ## PR context via gh CLI when available.

tokenBudget.description: Override per-section token limits for the active format. Values are approximate token counts (chars ÷ 4); sections truncate with an ellipsis when over budget. Keys match internal renderer section ids.

additionalProperties.description: Max estimated tokens for this section before truncation.

github.description: Deprecated alias for sections.github; prefer sections.github.
